protocol.control_scope: Task 2 only, because the three controls do not publish a complete Academic Task 1 prompt.
protocol.label_visibility: The model-facing packet contains no human scores or comments. Labels are stored separately.
limitations: This is a prompt-comparison development test, not the final untouched acceptance test.
Three Task 2 cases share one public teacher source; a fourth independently published Band 9 case is included.
The labels are public human practice assessments, not official IELTS test scores.

metric_definition: Mean absolute error across the four separately labelled criteria, not the overall band.
